thread.title: New Orleans Police investigate fatal shooting in Fifth District
thread.title_full: New Orleans Police investigate fatal shooting in Fifth District

author: Nola Reporter
title: New Orleans Police investigate fatal shooting in Fifth District
text:
The New Orleans Police Department is investigating a homicide by shooting that occurred on June 16 in the Fifth District, according to a June 17 statement.
Investigators said Fifth District officers responded to reports of a shooting shortly before 4:08 p.m. in the 1200 block of Bartholomew Street. Upon arrival, officers located an adult male victim suffering from multiple gunshot wounds.
The preliminary investigation revealed that the victim had arrived at the location in his vehicle when the suspect began firing shots at him. The victim was struck multiple times and transported by New Orleans EMS to a local hospital, where he was later pronounced deceased.
Police said the investigation remains ongoing, and no additional information is available at this time. The Orleans Parish Coroner’s Office will release the victim’s identity following notification of next of kin and will determine the official cause of death.
Anyone with information that may assist investigators is encouraged to contact NOPD Homicide Unit detectives at (504) 658-5300. Those wishing to provide information anonymously can contact Crimestoppers of Greater New Orleans at (504) 822-1111 or toll-free at 1-877-903-STOP. Tips can also be submitted online at www.crimestoppersgno.org.
